verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that BigQuery's Gemini-powered conversational analytics lets users talk to their data in natural language, including finding, joining and querying tables and visualizing results. It now also covers market basket questions, and data insights generates queries from table metadata. Nothing in the evidence shows these answers are grounded in a governed semantic layer or curated metric definitions that would prevent hallucinated joins; governance is only implied by general IAM roles on datasets and tables. Missing for 10: semantic layer or business-definition grounding for NL answers, documented safeguards against incorrect joins, explicit governance enforcement on NL queries, independent or hands-on corroboration of answer accuracy.
